answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy can be achieved via staked reputation tokens. Agents must stake significant, verifiable reputation, earned through provable value creation, to gain participation rights. An attacker creating numerous fake identities would need to accumulate equivalent legitimate reputation for each, representing an economic climb over a steep computational and social ridge. The cost is analogous to the patient cultivation required to grow a resilient willow or a vibrant field of yarrow, demanding non-duplicable, sustained effort rather than mere digital proliferation.
